clips.title: The story
paras: At Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, High Priestess Laurena trains human priests in devotion and arcane wards.
High Priestess Laurena holds a senior post in the Church of the Holy Light. She serves in Stormwind City's Cathedral of Light, the heart of the faith, where Archbishop Benedictus leads the Church.

Behind the central altar in the cathedral sanctuary, High Priestess Laurena mentors aspiring priests. Acolytes who show dedication and piety are sent to her for deeper study. She teaches sacred boons such as Desperate Prayer and defensive spells that turn enemy arcane magic against its wielders. When her students have learned all she can teach, she sends them to other master priests across the Alliance.
